meta.name: Neighborhood analysis (cellular neighborhoods)
meta.description: Find recurring tissue neighborhoods (niches) by Leiden-clustering each cell's local cell-type composition, writing a neighborhood label per cell to obs[neighborhood_key], and plot the neighborhood map + composition.
meta.provenance: Cellular neighborhoods (Schurch et al., Cell 2020), with Leiden community detection (Traag et al., Sci Rep 2019) in place of k-means. Step 4 of the Xenium region-analysis workflow.

readme: Step 4 of the workflow (run 'Assign cell-type labels (CellTypist)' first, or use any cell-type/cluster column). For each cell, counts the cell types among its spatial neighbours and groups those composition vectors into recurring niches with Leiden community detection, written to `obs[neighborhood_key]`. `neighborhood_resolution` controls how finely the compositions are split, so the number of niches follows from the data rather than being fixed up front. The plot shows the spatial neighborhood map, a cell-type × neighborhood enrichment heatmap, and the per-neighborhood composition. Needs `obsm['spatial']`. Follow with the by-region recipes (5 and 6).

params.name: cell_type_key
params.tooltip: cell-type/cluster column whose local composition defines the neighborhoods

params.name: neighborhood_resolution
params.tooltip: Leiden resolution: higher gives more, smaller neighborhoods (niches)

params.name: neighborhood_key
params.tooltip: obs column to write the neighborhood label into
